description: This PHP source file defines a Drupal migration process plugin class 'FieldLink' used to transform and canonicalize URL links from Drupal 6/7 formats to Drupal 8, handling URI schemes, internal/external URL patterns, and serialization of link attributes.

classes.name: FieldLink
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class for transforming legacy link URLs into Drupal 8-compatible format, handling URI schemes, internal/external URL patterns, and link attribute serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin, triggers deprecation warning, and sets default URI scheme to 'http://'.

methods.name: canonicalizeUri
methods.description: Converts Drupal 6/7 URLs into Drupal 8-compatible URIs, handling protocol prefixes, internal/external URL patterns, and special cases like '<front>' and empty links.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms input link data by unserializing attributes, canonicalizing the URL, and preparing the route array with URI, attributes, and title.
